title: Kissed With Tarragon Chinese Eggs Bao
description: A refreshing Chinese dish featuring tarragon, perfect for post-workout meals with a low-fat profile. Briny eggs, creamy sauce, and delicate buns are a match made in heaven.
instructions: Add 2 cups of water to a pot and bring to a boil.
Gently place 4-6 eggs into a papillote bag, leaving a small air pocket.
Place the eggs into the boiling water and cook for 6 minutes.
Prepare a sauce by whisking together 1 cup of low-fat milk, 1 tablespoon of tarragon, 2 tablespoons of chopped scallions, and 1 teaspoon of soy sauce in a small bowl.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium heat.
Gently pour the sauce into the pan and whisk until heated through.
Gently remove the eggs from the papillote bag and place them into the sauce.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the eggs are coated in the sauce.
Serve the eggs in the bao buns with a sprinkle of chopped spinach and a sprinkle of salt.
Garnish with additional chopped scallions if desired.
